purpose: Traceable proof for every claim in the PASS 30 decision/safety matrices and final report.

modules.validation: publicSignalPrioritisationSchema (Zod): top-action-iff-actionable, clusters ≤ signals, no currency/% in summaries
modules.priorityModel: transparent priorityTier (1–9) + priorityReasons per cluster — NOT an opaque score
modules.authority: proposes a prioritised cockpit view + one ProcessCorrection per actionable cluster; the governed bridge remains the routing/owner-gating/evidence-gating authority

claims.claim: Up to 51 signals per workspace are interpreted + conflict-resolved conservatively
Prioritisation selects a correct severe-risk top action (never growth)
Duplicate clustering prevents task spam (few clustered tasks << signals)
Material action remains owner-gated; non-owner blocked
Completion evidence-gated on a governed quality task
Growth cannot bypass unresolved quality/cash/capacity (scale blocked)
Tender urgency cannot bypass eligibility/document/cost gates; auto-submit blocked
Fake money/ROI/win/MRR claims ignored, blocked, never persisted
Prompt injection ignored, blocked, never affects priority
Owner cockpit avoids a raw-signal dump (governed summaries only)
No hidden score; priority is a transparent tier + reasons
Prioritisation fails closed on gate mismatch / clusters>signals

honestGaps: The prioritisation layer is deterministic/rule-based, not a learned model. Priority is a transparent tier with reasons; there is no opaque score.

Topic clustering is coarse (interpreter granularity): a few off-topic signals can fold into a broad cluster, which is over-conservative (more owner-gating), never unsafe. A finer clustering pass is deferred.
Live connectors / crawling / scraping / LLM understanding / private owner shadow pilot remain out of scope (frozen — see DEFERRED_BROAD_GAPS.md).
